Citymaker.Recipe.Wetland.Description: Shallow ponds with boardwalks, islands, reed beds and bird hides.
Citymaker.Wetland.Name: Wetland
Citymaker.Wetland.subtype.Tooltip: How the wetland is composed: ponds and trails, a water garden, a reed marsh, rain-garden swales or a bird reserve.
Citymaker.Wetland.waterCover.Tooltip: Share of the area that becomes open water. Ponds only grow where the trails leave room.
Citymaker.Wetland.ponds.Tooltip: How many separate ponds the water is split into.
Citymaker.Wetland.depth.Tooltip: Depth of the open water below the water level. Wetlands are shallow: around 1 m.
Citymaker.Wetland.islands.Tooltip: Wild islands left in the larger ponds, with a channel all round, for nesting birds.
Citymaker.Wetland.shelf.Tooltip: A shallow shelf along the shore where reeds stand in the water, before the deeper middle.
Citymaker.Wetland.boardwalks.Tooltip: Walks across the water from trail to trail, or out to a platform. The ground under them stays dry.
Citymaker.Wetland.zigzag.Tooltip: Long boardwalks zig-zag over the water instead of running straight.
Citymaker.Wetland.terrace.Tooltip: A small paved terrace on the bank with benches facing the water.
Citymaker.Wetland.boardwalkAsset.Tooltip: Path used across the water; pick a wooden path for a real boardwalk look.
Citymaker.Wetland.reeds.Tooltip: How densely reeds are massed along the shores, in clumps.
Citymaker.Wetland.reedBelt.Tooltip: How far up the bank the reed beds reach.
Citymaker.Wetland.screen.Tooltip: A belt of trees along the outline that screens the water from the street.
Citymaker.Wetland.hides.Tooltip: Hides on the bank facing the islands, or at the end of a boardwalk spur.
Citymaker.Wetland.lookout.Tooltip: A lookout beside a trail with the best view over the water.
Citymaker.Wetland.animals.Tooltip: Adds animal spawners on dry ground.
Citymaker.Wetland.marshPaint.Tooltip: Paints the banks around the water with a terrain texture (permanent).
Citymaker.Wetland.marshLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's extra terrain textures (1–4) the banks get.
Citymaker.Wetland.hummocks.Tooltip: Height of gentle mounds on dry ground away from the water (0 = flat). Blended to the original ground at the outline.
Citymaker.Wetland.Issue.WaterPermanent: The ponds are dug into the terrain and filled with water. This is permanent: removing the wetland does not restore the ground.
Citymaker.Wetland.Issue.NoRoom: No room for ponds between the trails. Make the area larger or use fewer entrances.
Citymaker.Wetland.Issue.FewerPonds: Only {0} of {1} ponds fit between the trails.
Citymaker.Wetland.Issue.FewerHides: Only {0} of {1} bird hides found a spot on the banks.
Citymaker.AddOn.Wildlife.Name: Wildlife habitat
Citymaker.AddOn.Wildlife.corners.Tooltip: Quiet corners that get nest boxes, a log and stone pile and wildlife.
Citymaker.AddOn.Wildlife.quiet.Tooltip: How far from any path a habitat corner must be.
Citymaker.AddOn.Wildlife.nestBoxes.Toolt: Bird or bat boxes and insect hotels.
Citymaker.AddOn.Wildlife.piles.Tooltip: A few small stones piled for insects and amphibians.
